title: eapache/go-resiliency breaker
notes: breaker.New(threshold, 1, openMs).Run(fn) for each call, the breaker created for each operation. Each time it opens it starts a goroutine that sleeps for the open time (100 ms); that goroutine and its wake-up are in this package's figures. The outcome is told by a flag the function sets, not by ErrBreakerOpen.
